description: Ethiopia Irrigated Lands is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC). This dataset contains the Ethiopian dataset on the Irrigated Lands, from the Waterdata, Global Irrigated Area for Mapping for the nominaL year of 2000 using satellite images at the resolution of about 5000 metres. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC). Its tags are geodata. It offers 1 resource(s) in GEOTIFF. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
